title: Auxiliary component identity for K-injective shift comparison
statement: For every ringed-space morphism and K-injective complex, the derived direct-image comparison after the inverse derived shift map equals the shifted comparison followed by the inverse localized shift identification.

proof.text: Transport the right-derived unit across the K-injective equivalence and use its naturality for the canonical shift map; identify the termwise image shift with the localized shift isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso_shift_aux
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ) [K.IsKInjective] :
    (derivedModuleDirectImage g).map
        ((DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).inv.app K) ≫
      (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g (K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)).hom =
    ((derivedModuleDirectImage g).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫
      (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g K).hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
      (moduleDirectImageLocalizedShiftIso g K).inv
